method: Independent current Web source review, local Server authorization/checkout contract inspection, finite public HTTPS headers and Cloudflare management readback; no remote business fixtures or writes.

findings.assessment: Confirmed deploy scripts downloaded an unpinned CLI; schema path was unavailable after npm ci. Supply-chain exposure rather than an observed compromise.
findings.resolution: Exact Wrangler 4.149.0 and dependency closure in lockfile; npm scripts call installed CLI. Node >=22.12 requirement matches Wrangler and CI. Full audit has zero advisories.

findings.assessment: Confirmed production accepted sandbox checkout host. Deleting creem.io/www.creem.io indiscriminately would break the current Server checkout contract.
findings.resolution: Sandbox host requires explicit VITE_CREEM_MODE=test and non-production mode. Retain actual exact live hosts; main domains require /checkout/ paths.

findings.assessment: Confirmed API key helper automatically enumerated up to 100 remote pages.
findings.resolution: One page per request; explicit Load more, scope/abort fences, deduplication, cursor progress checks and failed-page recovery retaining loaded records.

findings.assessment: Reported focus retry loop is not active in production: hook and stored-flag reader had no production callers. Unscoped dormant storage code was real design debt.
findings.resolution: Delete unused hook and stored flag writes; keep account-scoped bounded GitHub renewal, popup verification and explicit user failure recovery.

findings.assessment: Confirmed public HTTPS response lacked HSTS and Permissions-Policy. This is defense-in-depth; no exploit demonstrated.
findings.resolution: Host-only HSTS max-age=15552000 on HTTPS; disable unused camera/microphone/geolocation/payment capabilities and preserve clipboard.

findings.assessment: Confirmed duplicate hand-maintained CSP; existing drift test reduced immediate risk.
findings.resolution: Generate dist/_headers during Vite build from the module shared with Worker, retaining per-route cache controls and exact JSON-LD hashes.

additional_changes: Default Vite dev/preview to loopback with explicit CLI LAN opt-in.
Cancel discarded upstream response body without blocking fallback fetch.
Return validated parsed URL.href and reject raw controls/embedded credentials across trusted redirects. Original praise of GitHub guards was incomplete.
Pin official CI actions to verified immutable commit SHAs.
retained_items: CSV workspaceId query is explicitly supported in OpenAPI; Server rejects duplicate/empty/conflicting selectors and maps query to the same header-based authorization path, including streamed-page authorization.
Five-minute transport timeout is UX/design debt with per-request overrides; no latency evidence justifies broad timeout changes in this security release.
Large ledger screen is refactoring debt; avoid mixing concurrency-sensitive structural changes into security remediation.
limitations: No absolute absence-of-vulnerability claim; review and local assertions cover the stated scope.
No production sign-in, provider authorization, checkout, payment or data mutation was performed.
Only installed Chromium ran locally; Firefox/WebKit were unavailable. Existing CI retains all three browser engines.

local_verification.production_build: passed with explicit Norulo production origin and same-origin API
